title: Verbosa
description: Unified platform to interact with different AI language models like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and OpenRouter with dynamic model selection

data.text: Verbosa is a multi-provider AI chat developed with Flutter for responsive frontend and Go backend with WebSocket. It supports dynamic AI model selection (Gemini, GPT-4, Claude), real-time streaming messages, secure authentication with JWT, chat session management, project organization, and Material Design 3 adaptive interface for desktop and mobile. The system uses Riverpod for state management and repository pattern for API abstraction.

image_captions: Multi-provider AI chat interface with dynamic model selection and real-time streaming
